acceptance: RED first: a build cell has no knowledge-layer entries in its context index before the change
The knowledge layer holds the entries that evolve guidance index --audience phase --phase build --cli <seat CLI> --json prints
Changed functions at 100% coverage on every CI OS; the package note and the spec are updated
fix: In the context-index component, read guidance/index.json as the knowledge layer, filter its entries by the audience phase, by the phase name and by the family of the seat, and merge them into the layered context index of the cell. Use the shared entry fields id, layer, kind, summary, bytes, path and audience.
source: console, 2026-10-26, operator: "Extract the common rules, policies from claude / gemini / codex / ollama / etc... and build a structured system level indexes MD file to be loaded dynamically in the run time."
